predecessors.name: Republic of Venice
predecessors.text: Crete, the Venetian Kingdom of Candia

successors.name: Republic of Venice
successors.text: Crete, back under Venice after the revolt ended in 1368

ledger.x: 9 August 1363: the Venetian feudal lords of Crete declare the Republic of Saint Titus.
1368: 'The Kallergis brothers were captured by treason in April 1367, and the revolt ended in 1368.'
1368: the Republic of Saint Titus ends with the revolt.

wars.name: Revolt of St. Titus
wars.outcome: Venice retook Candia on 9 May 1364, captured the Kallergis brothers by treason in April 1367 and ended the revolt in 1368.

certainty.note: The page does not delimit the rebel-held land.
